events.name: D-Day Festival Normandy
events.when: annually around 6 June (festival period roughly late May to mid-June); 2026 edition approx. 30 May to 14 June
events.blurb: Annual festival commemorating the 1944 Allied landings, held across the D-Day beaches including Utah Beach and Sainte-Marie-du-Mont. Features ceremonies, historical re-enactments, military camps, exhibitions, concerts and parachute demonstrations.

events.name: Utah Beach D-Day Anniversary Ceremonies
events.when: annually in early June around the 6 June D-Day anniversary
events.blurb: Official commemorative ceremonies and tributes held at Utah Beach and at the Resistance monument in Sainte-Marie-du-Mont, including a parachute-packing demonstration with the ETO association and a bagpipe concert on the village church square.

events.name: Sainte-Marie-du-Mont Votive Festival (Fete votive)
events.blurb: Traditional village festival dedicated to the Virgin Mary, with a foot race, funfair rides, a carnival and fireworks.

events.name: Quatre Jours en Juin (Carentan 1944 Liberation Re-enactment)
events.when: annually in early June (around 4-7 June), centred on Carentan-les-Marais near Utah Beach
events.blurb: Multi-day living-history commemoration of the Battle and Liberation of Carentan, with a commemorative march of hundreds of re-enactors from many countries, military camps and period festivities. Organised by the Carentan Liberty Group.

events.name: Camp Geronimo (Airborne Museum, Sainte-Mere-Eglise)
events.when: annually in early June during the D-Day anniversary; 2026 edition approx. 3-7 June
events.blurb: Living-history military camp staged by the Airborne Museum in nearby Sainte-Mere-Eglise, recreating a 1944 airborne encampment with re-enactors, vehicles and demonstrations during the D-Day commemorations.

events.name: D-Day Festival Normandy
events.when: annually late May to mid-June; 2026 edition (20th) runs 30 May - 14 June 2026, with events across the Gold Beach sector (Arromanches-les-Bains, Asnelles, Ver-sur-Mer)
events.blurb: Large annual festival marking the anniversary of the 1944 Normandy landings, with over a hundred events including military vehicle parades, parachute drops, re-enactment camps, concerts, fireworks and memorial ceremonies across the D-Day beaches, including the Gold Beach sector around Arromanches and Asnelles.

events.name: D-Day Anniversary Commemoration (6 June)
events.when: annually on 6 June; 2026 marked the 82nd anniversary, with local ceremonies in Asnelles and along Gold Beach
events.blurb: Annual ceremonies on 6 June honour the Allied landings of 1944. In the Gold Beach sector the town of Asnelles holds commemorative gatherings and guided remembrance tours about civilian and military life during the landings.

events.name: British Normandy Memorial Service of Remembrance
events.when: annually on 6 June at the British Normandy Memorial in Ver-sur-Mer (Gold Beach); 2026 service held around 10:30-11:15am
events.blurb: Free annual service of remembrance at the British Normandy Memorial overlooking Gold Beach at Ver-sur-Mer, honouring the British and Commonwealth personnel who died during the Battle of Normandy, often attended by veterans.

events.name: Festival Les Embruns de Musique
events.when: annually in summer (July-August), with weekly Thursday classical concerts; 2026 edition (13th) around 15-23 July, performances also dated 16 July - 6 August
events.blurb: Classical music festival held each summer in Arromanches-les-Bains and nearby Bessin coastal communes, featuring violinist Patrick Bismuth and the ensemble La Tempesta with solo, duo and trio recitals (Beethoven, Schubert, Debussy, Fauré) in venues such as the Church of Arromanches.

events.name: Arromanches Summer Flea Market (Brocante)
events.when: annually in mid-July and mid-August in Arromanches-les-Bains
events.blurb: Seasonal antiques and flea market that fills the streets of Arromanches-les-Bains in mid-July and mid-August with stalls of antique and vintage objects.

events.name: Arromanches Christmas Market
events.blurb: Festive end-of-year Christmas market in Arromanches-les-Bains, accompanied locally by the Ali Baba solidarity toy flea market (Brocante du jouet) in early December.

events.name: D-Day Festival Normandy
events.when: annually late May to mid-June around the 6 June D-Day anniversary; 2026 edition (82nd anniversary) runs 30 May - 14 June 2026 across all landing beaches including Omaha Beach
events.blurb: Region-wide festival commemorating the 1944 Allied landings, with ceremonies, reenactment camps, period-vehicle parades and concerts staged on the D-Day beaches from Utah to Sword, including the Omaha Beach sector at Saint-Laurent-sur-Mer and Vierville-sur-Mer.

events.name: D-Day Anniversary Ceremony at the Normandy American Cemetery
events.when: annually on 6 June at the Normandy American Cemetery, Colleville-sur-Mer, just above Omaha Beach; 2026 marks the 82nd anniversary
events.blurb: Official ceremony honoring the American servicemen who died in the Normandy landings, held at the Normandy American Cemetery overlooking Omaha Beach, drawing veterans, officials and families each 6 June.

events.name: Memorial Day Ceremony at the Normandy American Cemetery
events.when: annually on the U.S. Memorial Day weekend (late May) at the Normandy American Cemetery, Colleville-sur-Mer; held 24 May in 2026
events.blurb: American Battle Monuments Commission Memorial Day observance honoring U.S. service members buried at the Normandy American Cemetery above Omaha Beach, attended by U.S. and French military, veterans and the local community.

events.name: Omaha Village (Le Village d'Omaha)
events.when: annually over the D-Day anniversary weekend in early June at Vierville-sur-Mer / Omaha Beach Campground; 2026 edition around 4-7 June
events.blurb: D-Day commemorative event organized by the D-Day Omaha Museum and the Omaha Beach campground, featuring period-vehicle parades, dynamic military demonstrations, torchlight marches, concerts and fireworks near Omaha Beach.

events.name: Omaha Beach Picnic and Fireworks (Saint-Laurent-sur-Mer)
events.when: annually on 6 June evening at Saint-Laurent-sur-Mer on Omaha Beach; 2026 from about 7:30 p.m. to 11:30 p.m.
events.blurb: Large seaside picnic on Omaha Beach at Saint-Laurent-sur-Mer with live concerts and a fireworks display, held each year on the evening of the D-Day anniversary.

events.name: Bedford Boys Tribute Ceremony
events.when: annually on 6 June at Vierville-sur-Mer, within the D-Day Festival
events.blurb: Ceremony at Vierville-sur-Mer paying tribute to the 19 soldiers from Bedford, Virginia, all killed on Omaha Beach on D-Day, 6 June 1944.

events.name: Omaha Festiv'
events.when: annually in summer (traditionally August) at Vierville-sur-Mer, the rock festival of Omaha Beach
events.blurb: Open-air rock music festival staged facing the sea at Vierville-sur-Mer on Omaha Beach, featuring local and regional bands with on-site catering.

events.name: D-Day Canadian Commemorative Ceremony at the Juno Beach Centre
events.when: annually on 6 June; 2026 ceremony on 6 June at 09:30 on the Garth Webb Esplanade
events.blurb: Annual ceremony at the Juno Beach Centre on Juno Beach honouring D-Day and the Battle of Normandy, with Canadian official attendance. Part of the wider 6 June commemorations on the Normandy landing beaches.

events.name: Fete de la Mer (Sea Festival) of Courseulles-sur-Mer
events.when: annually in August at the port and seafront; in recent years a memorial ceremony around 10 August plus a festive weekend in late August (23-24 Aug in 2025)
events.blurb: Maritime festival celebrating Courseulles' fishing-port heritage, combining a solemn ceremony honouring sailors lost at sea with a festive weekend of concerts, stands and seafaring traditions at the marina and beach.

events.name: Festival La Semaine Acadienne (Acadian Week)
events.when: annually in August across the Coeur de Nacre towns; 2026 edition (21st) from 7 to 15 August, including events at the Juno Beach Centre
events.blurb: Cultural festival paying tribute to Acadian soldiers who landed in Normandy in 1944 and celebrating living Acadian culture, with concerts and events across Saint-Aubin-sur-Mer, Courseulles-sur-Mer and neighbouring towns.

events.name: Acadian Soldiers Tribute Ceremony at the Juno Beach Centre
events.when: annually during Acadian Week in August; 2026 ceremony on 10 August at 09:30
events.blurb: Ceremony at the Juno Beach Centre honouring the Acadian soldiers who took part in the D-Day landings, held as part of the annual Semaine Acadienne festival.

events.name: Janvier Musiq'Halle
events.when: annually in January in Courseulles-sur-Mer; 2026 edition runs 10-31 January
events.blurb: Winter music festival in Courseulles-sur-Mer showcasing local artists with concerts and live performances.

events.name: D-Day Festival Normandy
events.when: annually in early June around the 6 June D-Day anniversary; 2026 edition 1-14 June, with ceremonies and a vehicle parade through Sword Beach on 5 June
events.blurb: Region-wide commemoration of the 1944 Allied landings spanning all five D-Day beaches including Sword Beach at Ouistreham/Colleville-Montgomery, with official ceremonies, vehicle parades, parachute drops, concerts and fireworks. 2026 marks the 82nd anniversary.

events.name: Fete de la Musique (Music Festival)
events.blurb: France's nationwide music day, celebrated in Ouistreham Riva-Bella with multiple open-air stages and free performances across the town.

events.name: Scallop and Seafood Festival (Fete de la Coquille)
events.blurb: Seafood celebration at Ouistreham's port with a fish market, grilled scallop skewers and special seafood menus in local restaurants.

events.name: Les Terrasses Musicales (Musical Terraces)
events.when: every Tuesday during July and August each summer
events.blurb: Series of free open-air evening concerts (jazz, pop, rock, world music) held on the seafront terraces of Ouistreham Riva-Bella throughout the summer.

events.name: Festival Tous en Scene
events.blurb: Two-day Ouistreham festival showcasing amateur and professional artistic practice with theatre, dance and live performances across the town's venues.

events.name: Normandy Beach Race
events.when: biennial (every two years) in September on Riva-Bella beach; last held September 2025, next expected 2027 (no 2026 edition)
events.blurb: Vintage motorsport festival on Riva-Bella beach in Ouistreham with races of pre-1947 motorcycles and cars, plus rockabilly concerts, a vintage village and 1940s-50s atmosphere. Held every two years; organisers warn there is no 2026 edition.

events.name: Delta Festival
events.when: annually in July on the Prado beaches; 2026 edition 23-26 July
events.blurb: One of France's largest youth music festivals, held directly on the Prado beaches with 6 stages, pool parties and after-parties, drawing around 150,000 attendees. The 2026 edition has a Rio Carnival theme.

events.name: Freestyle Cup Festival
events.when: annually in June on the Prado beach; 2026 edition 17-21 June
events.blurb: A free open-air festival combining extreme and water sports, giant yoga sessions and DJ concerts on the sand at Prado beach, mixing sport and music in a summer beach atmosphere.

events.name: Mondial La Marseillaise a petanque
events.when: annually in early July at Parc Borely (near Prado beach); 2026 edition 3-8 July
events.blurb: The world's largest petanque tournament, held at Parc Borely just inland from the Prado beaches. The 65th edition gathers around 13,000 players across all levels with free entry for spectators.

events.name: La Marseillaise des Femmes
events.when: annually in spring, starting on the Prado beaches; 2026 edition Sunday 10 May
events.blurb: A women's running event held since 2010, with an accessible 5.4 km course combining the Prado beaches, Parc Borely and Avenue du Prado. The 16th edition starts at 9:00 AM on the Prado beaches.

events.name: Marsatac Festival
events.when: annually in summer at Parc Borely (near Prado beach); 2026 edition 11-13 June
events.blurb: A long-running urban and electronic music festival held at Parc Borely, near the Prado beaches, featuring hip-hop, electro and contemporary music acts over several days.

events.name: Fete de la Musique
events.blurb: France's nationwide music celebration, with free concerts and street performances staged throughout Marseille on the summer solstice.

events.name: Fête Patronale de Sainte-Luce
events.when: annually; popular festivities late Jan to mid-Feb, religious feast 13 December
events.blurb: Sainte-Luce's annual patron-saint festival combines a religious celebration of Saint Lucy on 13 December with weeks of popular festivities featuring concerts, a traditional market, sporting events, cultural performances and carnival. The official town announced the 2026 edition running 31 January to 18 February 2026.

events.name: Carnaval de Martinique (Sainte-Luce)
events.blurb: Sainte-Luce takes part in the island-wide Martinique Carnival, whose climactic Jours Gras run 15-18 February 2026, ending with the burning of the effigy Vaval on Ash Wednesday. In Sainte-Luce the carnival is folded into the town's patronal festival with street parades and music.

events.name: Fête Patronale & Carnaval de Sainte-Luce
events.when: annually late January to mid-February (Carnival season)
events.blurb: Sainte-Luce's annual patron-saint festival and carnival features a traditional market, live concerts, sporting events, family activities, a school carnival parade and Ash Wednesday celebrations with the Vaval carnival figure. In 2026 it ran roughly 31 January to 18 February, with the main carnival day on 16 February.

events.name: Fête de la Sainte-Luce (feast of Saint Lucy)
events.blurb: The religious feast day of Saint Lucy, the town's patron saint, is celebrated annually on 13 December in Sainte-Luce, complementing the larger popular festivities held during the carnival season.

events.name: Foire de Bourail (Bourail Agricultural Fair)
events.blurb: New Caledonia's largest and most iconic agricultural, craft and cultural fair, held annually since 1977 at the Tene site in Bourail and drawing 25,000-30,000 visitors. Highlights include the famous rodeo, agricultural and woodcutting contests, local food, and the Miss Foire de Bourail pageant.

events.name: ANZAC Day Commemoration at Nessadiou
events.blurb: ANZAC Day is commemorated each 25 April at the New Zealand military cemetery of Nessadiou in Bourail, honouring Australian and New Zealand soldiers, with a related 'War in Paradise' exhibition shown in the region.

events.name: New Caledonia Surfing Championship (Bourail)
events.blurb: The New Caledonia surfing championship is contested on Bourail's surf spots, serving as a qualifier ahead of national events and the 2027 Pacific Games.

events.name: Queen Classic Surf Festival
events.blurb: A free inclusive longboard surf festival held directly on the Côte des Basques beach, gathering top female surfers for competitions, conferences, art installations and performances. Recent editions ran in mid-September (12-14 September 2025).

events.name: Rat's Cup Festival
events.blurb: A three-day event on the Côte des Basques beach combining high-level surf competitions, skateboard demonstrations and live concerts, running from morning into the night.

events.name: Biarritz Pays Basque Maider Arosteguy
events.blurb: Created in 1984, Europe's oldest surf competition marks the official opening of the French surf season, held in Biarritz (on the Grande Plage) around the Easter weekend with around 250 surfers across all categories.

events.name: Le Temps d'Aimer la Danse
events.blurb: An international dance festival in Biarritz, created in 1990 and held each September, featuring dozens of classical, contemporary and traditional Basque dance performances by leading companies.

events.name: Fête de la Saint-Pierre
events.blurb: Three-day maritime tradition in Le Grau-du-Roi where fishermen honour their patron Saint Peter and commemorate sailors lost at sea, with processions, blessing of the sea and community festivities.

events.name: Fête Votive du Grau-du-Roi (La Fête du Grau)
events.blurb: The town's main 10-day votive festival celebrating Camargue traditions with bull releases, courses camarguaises in the arena, abrivados, bandidos, encierros and popular dances. The 2026 edition marks its 80th anniversary.

events.name: Fête de la Mer
events.blurb: A maritime festival in the fishing port of Le Grau-du-Roi celebrating the town's seafaring heritage with events centred on the sea and local traditions.

events.name: Courses Camarguaises (Camargue bull races)
events.when: throughout the summer season at the Arènes du Grau-du-Roi
events.blurb: Traditional Camargue bull races held at the town's arena, where raseteurs attempt to snatch ribbons from the bulls' horns, a regional sport rather than a bullfight, staged regularly during the festive season.

events.name: Festival des Anches d'Azur
events.blurb: An international festival for lovers of wind/reed instruments, with daytime concerts held in the village and on the nearby Landing beach (plage du Debarquement, by Gigaro) and gala concerts in the evening.

events.name: Fete Locale de La Croix-Valmer
events.blurb: The town's annual local festival features parades in the village centre, inflatable games, exhibitions, a sardinade (grilled sardine feast) and a laser show.

events.name: Marche Nocturne (Summer Night Market)
events.when: every Thursday evening, late June to early September
events.blurb: A craft and artisanal night market held in the village centre on Thursday evenings throughout the summer, offering local products, decorative objects and gift ideas.

events.name: Festival Folklorique Portugais (Portuguese Folklore Festival)
events.blurb: A cultural festival organised by the local Esperanca association celebrating Portuguese folklore with traditional music and dance; the event recently held its 27th edition.

events.name: Grand'Anse en l'Air
events.blurb: A festive seaside night market held right at Grande Anse beach featuring local artisans, creators and producers, food stalls and live concerts, organized by La Bande à Guinguette. Free admission, running afternoon to late evening.

events.name: Fête de l'Ail (Garlic Festival)
events.blurb: Petite-Île's flagship annual festival celebrating locally grown garlic, a staple of Creole cuisine. Three days of market stalls, garlic-peeling and garlic-race contests, family activities, shows and concerts in the town centre (34th edition held in 2025).

events.name: Course de l'ail
events.blurb: An annual trail running race held during Petite-Île's garlic festival, with the historic 20 km course starting directly from Grande Anse beach and climbing through the hills toward the town centre and Domaine du Relais.

events.name: Fête de l'ail (Garlic Festival)
events.blurb: Petite-Île's signature annual festival celebrating locally grown garlic, a staple of Réunionese cuisine, combining market stalls, concerts and sporting events including the Course de l'ail trail race.

events.name: Grand'Anse en l'air
events.blurb: A festive weekend market at Grand'Anse organised by the association AREC Solidari'Terre, bringing together local creators, artisans and producers to showcase handmade goods and regional products.

events.name: Fête de la Musique - Petite-Île
events.blurb: The town of Petite-Île marks the annual Fête de la Musique with live performances featuring traditional séga, maloya and contemporary rhythms.

events.name: Biarritz Pays Basque Maider Arosteguy
events.blurb: Europe's oldest surf competition, created in 1984, held directly on the Grande Plage of Biarritz. The 40th edition brings together around 250 amateur and professional surfers competing for a 20,000 euro prize purse.

events.name: Wheels and Waves
events.blurb: Long-running Biarritz festival blending motorcycle culture, surfing, skating, BMX, art and music, centred around the Cite de l'Ocean and Milady Beach. The 15th edition runs 10-14 June 2026.

events.name: Queen Classic Surf Festival
events.blurb: Free inclusive surf festival held on Biarritz's Cote des Basques beach, celebrating longboarding and diversity with competitions, conferences and art.

events.name: Biarritz Piano Festival
events.when: annually late July to early August (2026: 27 July - 7 August)
events.blurb: Annual classical piano festival in Biarritz, reaching its 17th edition in 2026 with performances across the town.

events.name: Fête de la Mer (Sea Festival), Port Saint-Gildas
events.blurb: Houat's traditional sea festival held at Port Saint-Gildas, with grilled sardines, a refreshment stand and festivities celebrating the island's maritime and fishing heritage.

events.name: Festival Les Insulaires
events.when: annually in September (roving festival, hosted on Île de Houat)
events.blurb: A travelling festival of music and culture celebrating the islands of the Ponant, which Houat has hosted (10th edition in September 2023); it rotates among Breton islands such as Belle-Île, Hoëdic, Groix and Houat.

events.name: Mondial du Vent
events.blurb: International board-sports festival held on La Franqui beach since 1996, featuring the French stage of the GWA Wingfoil World Cup, the IFCA Windsurf Slalom Fin & Foil World Championship, kitesurf and windsurf demos, and a beachside Village de la Glisse. It draws large crowds each spring.

events.name: La Franqui Custom Beach
events.blurb: Recurring beachside gathering on La Franqui blending custom motorcycle and American car culture, water sports, street art and concerts, organized with the Harley-Davidson Perpignan dealership.

events.name: Marche Art, Artisanat et Saveurs de La Franqui
events.blurb: Summer evening arts, crafts and food market held at La Pointe in La Franqui, alongside regular morning markets on Mondays and Thursdays from mid-June to mid-September.

events.name: La Trois-Bassinoise
events.blurb: A long-running trail running race based in Trois-Bassins, starting from the church plaza, with a 51 km (2,700 m D+) and a 28 km (1,400 m D+) course through the western highlands. The 2026 edition is its 21st.

events.name: VéloRun Festival
events.blurb: A two-day cycling festival held in Trois-Bassins in the forested highlands, featuring a paired VéloRun Challenge, a regional youth mountain-bike trophy, a gourmet cycling tour and a climbers' trophy, plus a wellness village with music and activities.

events.name: Festival de l'Océan
events.blurb: An annual ocean-themed festival held each year since 2014 along Réunion's west coast between Le Port and Saint-Leu, with free or discounted introductory sessions in diving, paddleboarding, kayaking, sailing and fishing alongside marine conservation activities.

events.name: Fèt Kaf
events.blurb: Island-wide celebration commemorating the abolition of slavery in Réunion, marked locally in Trois-Bassins with music and festivities every 20 December.

events.name: Fête de la Musique
events.blurb: Trois-Bassins marks the nationwide French music day with free open-air concerts, dancing and a festive atmosphere.

events.name: Plein phare sur le Minou
events.blurb: A festive, family event held at the Pointe du Minou around the Petit Minou lighthouse, organised by the town of Plouzané. The 2025 edition featured artworks by sculptor Mich Mao, music and dancing, and launched a heritage fundraising campaign to restore the lighthouse.

events.name: Fête de la Musique - Plouzané
events.blurb: Plouzané's edition of France's annual music day, held on Place de la Republique with live musicians from 7pm to 9pm followed by the Bal Floc'h from 9pm.

events.name: Festivoce
events.blurb: Corsica's oldest music festival, held every July since 1991 in the hilltop village of Pigna in the Balagne, a short drive from Lozari. It features around 30 concerts across several village stages celebrating Corsican, Mediterranean and world voices and music.

events.name: Fête de Saint Erasme (Saint Erasmus, fishermen's festival)
events.blurb: L'Île-Rousse honours Saint Erasmus, the patron saint of sailors and fishermen, with a Mass, a procession through town from the church to the Quai d'Orléans and a blessing of the sea from the môle. It is a longstanding Corsican maritime tradition celebrated in early June.

events.name: Foire de L'Île-Rousse
events.blurb: An annual five-day fair on Place Paoli and in the centre of L'Île-Rousse with around a hundred artisans selling Corsican crafts, products and gastronomy, plus a funfair and free evening concerts.

events.name: Wheels and Waves
events.blurb: Annual motorcycle, surf, skate, art and music festival whose main village sits at the Cite de l'Ocean, directly between Milady and Ilbarritz beaches in southern Biarritz. The 2026 edition runs June 10-14 with races, surf competitions, an exhibition and concerts.

events.name: Hotdogger Surf Festival
events.blurb: A retro and vintage surf culture festival in Biarritz featuring a board village, exhibitions, skateboarding, concerts and the Hotdogger Trophy surf contest on vintage boards. Held annually in late May.

events.name: Queen Classic Surf Festival
events.blurb: A free inclusive surfing and longboarding festival held each September on Biarritz's Cote des Basques, welcoming surfers of all genders, orientations and skill levels.

events.name: Maider Arosteguy Surf Competition
events.blurb: Recognized as the oldest surf competition in Europe (created in 1984), this spring event is a season highlight held on the Grande Plage of Biarritz.

events.name: Journée de la Glisse (Slide Sports Day)
events.blurb: A free seafront watersports day at Hendaye-plage offering surf, stand-up paddle, Hawaiian pirogue, kayak and skateboarding initiations, held on the beachfront by the former Casino.

events.name: Fête de la Mer (Sea Festival)
events.blurb: Hendaye's annual seaside festival with musical entertainment, water activities, children's games, a traditional trainière (fishing boat) race and a creators' market along the waterfront.

events.name: Hendaye Fête l'Été (Summer Festival)
events.blurb: Hendaye's summer celebration featuring live performances on July 10-11 and a fireworks display on July 13, 2026.

events.name: Festival Musikolore
events.blurb: A world music festival held in Hendaye, running from June 30 to July 3, 2026.

events.name: San Ghjuvanni (Feast of Saint John the Baptist)
events.blurb: Porto-Vecchio's most cherished traditional festival, blending the sacred and festive with a torchlit procession, bonfires and the symbolic leaping over flames. After mass on 24 June, locals celebrate through the night.

events.name: Festival di u Luddareddu
events.when: annually night of 31 July to 1 August
events.blurb: A Porto-Vecchiese tradition in which a straw mannequin (the Luddareddu, symbolizing the harsh month of July) is judged, hanged and burned at midnight to expel misfortune, accompanied by workshops, concerts and popular festivities.

events.name: Fête de la Musique
events.blurb: France's nationwide free music celebration, held in Porto-Vecchio as across Corsica, with concerts in the streets and squares of the old town. In 2026 it falls on Sunday 21 June.

events.name: Festival de Gwoka de Sainte-Anne
events.when: annually in July (typically the second week)
events.blurb: A major annual festival in Sainte-Anne celebrating gwoka, the traditional Guadeloupean music, song and dance recognized by UNESCO, with concerts, workshops and street performances. Recent editions have been held across Sainte-Anne, Saint-Francois and La Desirade.

events.name: Fete Patronale de Sainte-Anne
events.when: annually around 26 July (Saint Anne's feast day)
events.blurb: Sainte-Anne's patron saint festival, held around late July to mark Saint Anne's feast day, with official ceremonies, music, contests, popular gatherings and fireworks.

events.name: Carnaval de Sainte-Anne
events.when: annually January to February (carnival season, Mardi Gras)
events.blurb: Part of the wider Guadeloupe carnival season, Sainte-Anne hosts colorful parades (deboules), costumed dancers and live music during the January to February carnival period.

events.name: Fête Patronale de Sainte-Rose (Sainte Rose de Lima)
events.blurb: The patronal festival of Sainte-Rose, the commune in which Plage de Clugny lies, honours Sainte Rose de Lima. Held in August, it features Mass, a parade through town, carnival groups and a stage of local artists over several days.

events.name: Fête Patronale de Deshaies (Saint-Pierre et Saint-Paul)
events.when: annually late June (last weekend of June)
events.blurb: The neighbouring fishing village of Deshaies, just along the coast from Plage de Clugny, celebrates its patron saints Saint Peter and Saint Paul on the last weekend of June with harbour festivities, the blessing of boats, a maritime procession, parade and dancing.

events.name: Fête des Cuisinières (Festival of Women Cooks)
events.blurb: A traditional Guadeloupean Creole-cuisine festival held around 15 August in honour of Saint Laurent, the patron of cooks. Women cooks parade in madras dress carrying decorated dishes; it is one of the island's signature culinary celebrations.

events.name: Plage Musicale à Belle-Île (formerly Festival de Bangor)
events.blurb: Chamber music festival founded in 2006 in Bangor (now island-wide), presenting around ten concerts in heritage sites such as the churches, the Grand Phare, Pointe des Poulains and the port of Sauzon, alongside a music academy. The 20th edition runs 18-29 July 2026.

events.name: Surfing at Plage de Donnant
events.blurb: Donnant, a west-facing beach in Bangor, is one of Brittany's best surf and bodyboard spots and hosts surf schools and club sessions (Surfin' Belle-Île, BISC) running courses and events throughout the year.

events.name: Belle-Île-en-Livres (Book Festival)
events.when: annually; salons at Sauzon (Salle Sarah Bernhardt) and Le Palais
events.blurb: Annual literary festival of Belle-Île-en-Mer featuring author meetings and book signings, with salons held at the Salle Sarah Bernhardt in Sauzon and venues in Le Palais.

events.name: Festival Étonnants Voyageurs
events.blurb: One of France's largest international literary festivals, drawing around 150 authors and 50,000 visitors to venues across Saint-Malo for talks, debates, readings and film screenings. The 2026 edition runs 23-25 May with Lebanon as guest country.

events.name: Festival Folklores du Monde
events.blurb: International festival of world music and dance held in Saint-Malo, with troupes from around the globe performing in the streets and squares of the walled city. The 2026 edition marks its 30th anniversary.

events.name: La Route du Rock - Collection Été
events.blurb: Long-running indie and rock music festival staged at Saint-Malo's Fort de Saint-Père and other emblematic venues, featuring major and emerging international artists. The 2026 summer edition is its 34th, running 12-15 August.

events.name: Festival Quai des Bulles
events.blurb: Major French comic-book (bande dessinee) festival held at the Palais du Grand Large in Saint-Malo, with over 150 stands and hundreds of authors. The 2026 edition is its 45th, on 9-11 October.

plage-de-la-chambre-d-amour-anglet.beach: Plage De La Chambre D Amour Anglet

events.name: Caraïbos Surf de Nuit Anglet
events.blurb: A World Surf League Specialty Event and the world's only night surfing competition, held at the Chambre d'Amour beach breaks in Anglet with LED-laminated surfboards, glowing balloons and DJs lighting the arena after dark.

events.name: International Surf Film Festival Anglet
events.blurb: A long-running surf cinema festival where giant screens on the Chambre d'Amour site offer free open-air film screenings facing the ocean.

events.name: Les Nocturnes de la Chambre d'Amour
events.blurb: Free open-air evening concerts on the Chambre d'Amour seafront organised by the town of Anglet, returning for its tenth year with two nights of live music by the ocean (2026 line-up includes Imany and Charlie Winston).

events.name: Anglet Summer Fest
events.blurb: A seaside festival of board-sport culture featuring DJ sets, concerts, skate demonstrations and competitions, brand villages and artist exhibitions along the Anglet coast.

events.name: Le Rêve d'Icare
events.blurb: An annual aeronautical and space festival held directly on the Plage de la Grande Conche in Royan, featuring aircraft displays and aviation activities. The 2026 edition is its 24th, running since 1989.

events.name: Festival Musiques et Gastronomie du Monde
events.blurb: A long-running Royan festival combining world music and international gastronomy, which celebrated its 30th anniversary in recent years.

events.name: Festival Royan-Orgues
events.blurb: A festival of organ and contemporary music in Royan, with concerts, conferences and events centred on the town's historic Boisseau organ.

events.name: International Surf Film Festival (Festival International du Film de Surf)
events.blurb: Free open-air surf cinema festival held on Anglet's Chambre d'Amour beachfront, combining film screenings on giant screens with surfing, exhibitions and concerts. It is one of surfing's major cultural film events, running for over two decades.

events.name: Anglet Beach Rugby Festival
events.when: annually late July / early August (2026: 30 July - 2 August)
events.blurb: Created in 1992, this is the oldest and largest beach rugby tournament in France, played on the sand at Anglet's Plage de la Barre. It draws teams and crowds for a festive weekend of beach sport.

events.name: Anglet Summer Fest
events.when: annually in summer (early August), ten-day run
events.blurb: A ten-day summer celebration on Anglet's beaches bringing together surf, skate, music and exhibitions, with DJ sets, concerts and skate demonstrations and competitions.

events.name: Festival Les Jours Heureux
events.blurb: An open-air music festival held in Anglet, reaching its 15th edition in 2026 with concerts across several days. It is a key spring cultural event in the town.

plage-de-la-mine-d-or.beach: Plage De La Mine D Or

events.name: Le Printemps part en live
events.blurb: A free family spring festival in Pénestin featuring three live concerts (chanson française, folk-blues and pop), a plant swap, a local makers' and producers' market, and food and drink stalls.

events.name: Fête de la Moule
events.blurb: An annual summer mussel festival at the port of Tréhiguier in Pénestin, serving the town's famous bouchot mussels and fries (moules-frites) alongside sea shanties, music and entertainment.

events.name: Les Mouclades d'Automne
events.blurb: An autumn celebration of Pénestin's bouchot mussels organised by the Confrérie des Bouchoteurs, gathering around fifty French brotherhoods for its grand annual chapter on the first weekend of October.

events.name: Barneville International Gliss'Festival
events.blurb: Action board-sports festival on the Grande Plage de Barneville and the seafront boulevard, featuring world-class riders in BMX, roller and other gliding disciplines. The 2026 edition marks its 10th anniversary and was rebranded as an international event.

events.name: Fête de la Mer (Sea Festival)
events.blurb: Traditional maritime festival in Barneville-Carteret with a ceremony at the sailors' monument, a mass at the fishing port, a wreath-tossing tribute at sea, concerts throughout the day and an evening fireworks display.

events.name: Contes a tous vents (Storytelling on the Beach)
events.blurb: Evening storytelling sessions held on the Plage de la Vieille Eglise in Barneville-Carteret, an open-air cultural event tied directly to this beach.

events.name: Marches de Barneville-Carteret (Local Markets)
events.when: Carteret Thursday to Saturday and Barneville on Sundays (July 1 to August 31)
events.blurb: Seasonal open-air markets selling local produce and goods, held in Carteret from Thursday to Saturday and in Barneville on Sundays during July and August.

events.name: Fête du Sel (Salt Festival), Salin-de-Giraud
events.blurb: Traditional free festival in Salin-de-Giraud honouring the salt workers of the Camargue, with a salt blessing on horseback, a village procession to the arena, gardian horseman games, a regional meal and Provençal folk performances.

events.name: Festival du Sel (concert evening), Salin-de-Giraud
events.blurb: Evening event in Salin-de-Giraud combining concerts, DJ sets and performances set against the salt-marsh landscape, with food trucks and a bar.

events.name: Pèlerinage des Gitans aux Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer
events.blurb: Major Roma pilgrimage in the Camargue town of Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer venerating Saint Sara, patron of the Gypsies, including a procession that carries the saints' statues down to the sea on the beach.

events.name: Fête des Gardians, Arles
events.blurb: Emblematic Camargue festival held each 1 May in Arles by the Confrérie des Gardians in honour of their patron Saint George, featuring a costumed parade, a traditional mass and gardian games in the Arles arena.

events.name: Fête de la mer
events.blurb: A traditional sea festival in Le Croisic celebrated for over a century, combining religious tradition with festivities including a nautical parade, folkloric shows, concerts and fireworks.

events.name: Tempo Festival Le Croisic
events.blurb: An annual music festival held over four days at the Ancienne Criée by the harbour in Le Croisic, returning in 2026 for its 17th edition. The 2026 edition highlights women musicians and composers.

events.name: Festival du Film De la Page a l'Image Le Croisic - Guerande
events.blurb: A long-running film festival in Le Croisic celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2026 with an expanded scope extending to the medieval town of Guerande, under its new name.

events.name: Karukera One Love Festival
events.blurb: An annual open-air music festival held directly on Plage de Roseau in Capesterre-Belle-Eau, featuring DJ sets, guest artists, beach foam parties and a seaside atmosphere. The 2026 edition takes place on 4 and 5 July.

events.name: Kapes Kannaval (Carnival of Capesterre-Belle-Eau)
events.blurb: Capesterre-Belle-Eau's Carnival weekend features night percussion-group parades, a children's carnival and King/Queen election, culminating in the grand Kapes Kannaval parade. The 2026 edition runs 6 to 8 February.

events.name: Journees du Patrimoine de Capesterre-Belle-Eau (Heritage Days)
events.blurb: Annual European Heritage Days in Capesterre-Belle-Eau, with exhibitions and guided visits at the town's emblematic monuments and historic sites.

events.name: Océanes Beach Festival
events.when: annually May to July (6 free concert evenings)
events.blurb: A free open-air music festival held at Place des Océanes in Pornichet, facing the ocean, with a series of evening concerts spread from May to early July. The 2026 edition features six concert evenings of rock, soul and pop acts.

events.name: Summer Evening Horse Races at the Hippodrome de Pornichet
events.when: annually, Thursday evenings in July and August
events.blurb: The Hippodrome de Pornichet hosts a popular series of summer evening flat-racing meetings (over thirty races per year), with gates opening in the late afternoon. The 2026 summer calendar includes Thursday meetings in July and August.

events.name: Fête des Courses (Hippodrome Family Race Day)
events.when: annually in August at the Hippodrome de Pornichet
events.blurb: A family-oriented race day at the Pornichet racecourse with free games and entertainment for children, live music and food trucks, held alongside the summer horse-racing programme.

events.name: Pornichet Markets and Flea Market (Braderie)
events.when: annually; regular markets plus a large braderie in the town centre
events.blurb: Pornichet holds regular markets and a large annual flea market (braderie) in its town-centre streets, drawing thousands of bargain-hunters each year.

events.name: Trail du Cap Sizun - Pointe du Raz
events.blurb: Annual coastal trail running event in Cap Sizun, with races of 15 km, 30 km and 52 km along the cliff paths past Pointe du Raz, Pointe du Van and the Baie des Trepasses. The 2026 edition is the 13th, organised by the Rederien Cap-Sizun association.

events.name: Fete de la Musique a Audierne
events.blurb: France's nationwide music festival is celebrated in Audierne with free open-air concerts from local and regional groups across the town. It takes place each year around the summer solstice on 21 June.

events.name: Fete de la Mer (SNSM Baie d'Audierne)
events.blurb: Maritime celebration organised by the SNSM lifeboat station of the Baie d'Audierne, with harbour-side festivities honouring local sea traditions and the town's fishing heritage.

events.name: Karujet - International Jet Ski Championship
events.blurb: The Karujet is an international jet ski championship held in Guadeloupe with its main racing venue on the plan d'eau de Viard at Plage de Viard in Petit-Bourg. The multi-day competition draws around a hundred riders and counts toward the world championship.

events.name: Fête Patronale de Petit-Bourg
events.blurb: Petit-Bourg's annual patron-saint festival, a major multigenerational cultural event with stands, performances and activities. In 2026 it runs from 7 to 16 August.

events.name: Tournoi International de Beach Volley des Catalans
events.blurb: France's oldest beach volleyball tournament, a free 3x3 competition held on the sand of Plage des Catalans, organized by the Club de Volley Ball des Catalans (CVBC) for over 70 years and drawing top French and European players. The 2026 edition runs 10-12 July.

events.name: Blues sur la plage
events.blurb: Free open-air blues concert held in the evening directly on the Plage des Libraires, facing the Casino on Boulevard des Oceanides, traditionally followed by a fireworks display at sunset. Organised with the Casino of Pornichet, it has run for over a dozen editions.

events.name: Oceanes Beach Festival
events.when: annually May to early July (2026: 7, 17, 23 May; 7, 19 June; 3 July)
events.blurb: A series of six free evening concerts held on the Place des Oceanes facing the ocean in Pornichet. The 2026 line-up includes Rock'n Roll Express, Vertical, Mazingo, Kurddie Dalle and Mister French.

events.name: Fete de la Musique
events.blurb: Pornichet joins France's nationwide music day with open stages, DJ sets and concerts across the town's squares and seafront, including Place des Oceanes and the Mazy district. Participation is free and open to local musicians and associations.

events.name: Renc'Arts a Pornichet
events.blurb: A summer street-arts programme in which performers from around the world take over Pornichet's neighbourhoods each evening from mid-July to mid-August. Free outdoor entertainment across the seaside town.

events.name: Aqua Music Festival
events.blurb: A two-day open-air music festival held at the Stade de Saint-François, a short distance from Plage des Raisins Clairs. The 2026 edition (3rd) is themed 'Sous le soleil de Rio' and includes 'La Grande Parade' on August 2.

events.name: Fête du Poisson et de la Mer (Festival of Fish and the Sea)
events.blurb: Saint-François celebrates its fishing heritage with a festival on the seafront featuring demonstrations of traditional fishing (trawling, trap-making, cast-net throwing), water sports and local seafood. The town is one of Guadeloupe's main fishing ports.

events.name: Carnaval de Guadeloupe - Saint-François Parade
events.when: annually in February (Carnival season); 2026 night parade on Lundi Gras, 16 February
events.blurb: As part of the wider Guadeloupe Carnival, Saint-François hosts a large nighttime parade ('Grande Parade Nocturne') on Lundi Gras with costumed groups and traditional Caribbean music.

events.name: Tour des Yoles Rondes de Martinique (start and finish in Sainte-Anne)
events.blurb: Martinique's flagship traditional sailing regatta, racing colorful round-bottom 'yoles'. The 40th edition (2026) both departs from and finishes in Sainte-Anne, the town nearest Plage des Salines, over eight coastal stages.

events.name: Fete Patronale de Sainte-Anne (Saint Anne's Day Festival)
events.blurb: Sainte-Anne's patron saint festival held around 26 July in honor of Saint Anne, with a week or more of masses, religious processions, concerts and sports competitions in the town nearest Plage des Salines.

events.name: Carnaval de Sainte-Anne
events.blurb: Sainte-Anne's Carnival runs from Epiphany to Shrovetide with street parades, costume contests and traditional music groups, part of Martinique's island-wide Carnival season.

events.name: Tour de Martinique des Yoles Rondes (Le Diamant stage)
events.blurb: Martinique's famous week-long traditional sailing race (yoles rondes) regularly includes a stage hosted by Le Diamant, with the finish line on the Grande Anse beach amid markets, Creole music and a festive seaside atmosphere. The 2026 edition runs in the July 26 to August 2 window.

events.name: Fete Patronale du Diamant (Saint Thomas)
events.when: patron saint Saint Thomas, late December (festivities around Dec 21)
events.blurb: Le Diamant celebrates its patron saint, Saint Thomas, with a solemn mass and religious ceremonies; the parish feast day is December 21. Wider community festivities are traditionally organised around the patronal celebration.

events.name: Wheels and Waves
events.blurb: Annual Biarritz festival celebrating custom motorcycles, surf, skate and music with a village at the Cité de l'Océan featuring live shaping, concerts, exhibitions and test rides.

events.name: Biarritz Pays Basque Maider Arosteguy
events.blurb: The oldest surf competition in Europe (created in 1984), held on Biarritz's Grande Plage. The 40th edition is scheduled for late October 2026.

events.name: Hotdogger Surf Festival
events.blurb: Annual retro surf culture festival in Biarritz featuring a village, competition, exhibitions and music over three days.

events.name: Queen Classic Surf Festival
events.blurb: An inclusive surf and longboard festival held on the Côte des Basques beach in Biarritz, celebrating diversity in surfing. The 2026 edition returns in September with the program announced over the summer.

events.name: Bénédiction de la mer et des bateaux (Blessing of the Sea and Boats)
events.blurb: On the Feast of the Assumption, the island holds a traditional Breton blessing of the sea and fishing boats at the Saint-Gildas church on Houat, a long-standing coastal maritime custom. Houat remains a small fishing community where this seafarers' blessing is observed each year.

events.name: Fête des Voisins (Neighbours' Day)
events.blurb: The island community of Houat takes part in the nationwide Fête des Voisins, a neighbourhood gathering organised locally by residents. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 22 April according to the Houat town hall.

events.name: Fête des Voiles Rouges
events.blurb: Biennial maritime festival at Port-Anna in Séné celebrating the town's seafaring heritage with a gathering of sinagots and traditional red-sailed boats, nautical activities, sea-shanty concerts, Breton music and quayside festivities. Entry and parking are free.

events.name: Festival La P'Art Belle
events.blurb: Eco-responsible micro-festival held each September in Séné, within the Gulf of Morbihan Regional Nature Park, with two days of concerts by emerging and committed artists, family shows, workshops and round tables on environmental themes.

events.name: Semaine du Golfe du Morbihan
events.when: biennial, Ascension week in odd years (next edition 3-9 May 2027)
events.blurb: Major biennial maritime event in which over a thousand traditional and heritage sailing boats cruise the Gulf of Morbihan, calling each evening at a different port among the seventeen participating gulf-shore communes including Séné and Vannes.

events.name: Fête de la Musique
events.blurb: France's nationwide music festival is staged in Pamandzi on Petite-Terre, with around ten local and regional artists performing on the Place des Congrès, organised by the Communauté de Communes de Petite-Terre. Edition dates and security conditions vary year to year.

events.name: Trépidanses
events.blurb: A dance and performing-arts festival on Petite-Terre organised by the Kazyadance company, held on the town-hall square of Dzaoudzi-Labattoir, featuring contemporary dance, theatre, music and puppetry with artists from Mayotte, Africa and mainland France.

events.name: Foires de l'Aïd / fin de Ramadan
events.when: annually during the last days of Ramadan / Aïd
events.blurb: Family-friendly fairs marking the end of Ramadan and the Aïd celebrations are held at the Place des Congrès in Pamandzi, promoted by the Office de Tourisme de Petite-Terre in this predominantly Muslim French territory.

events.name: Fête Patronale des Saintes (Fête des Marins et Pêcheurs)
events.blurb: Terre-de-Haut's five-day patronal festival honoring fishermen and sailors, centered on a solemn mass and Te Deum on 15 August commemorating a 17th-century event. Festivities include sailboat and canoe-kayak regattas held on the beach and at the landing dock, underwater fishing contests, the Miss Terre-de-Haut election, concerts and a closing fireworks display.

events.name: Carnaval de Terre-de-Haut (Les Saintes)
events.when: annually in the weeks before Lent (February/March)
events.blurb: Terre-de-Haut holds its own annual Carnival in the Les Saintes archipelago, with costumed parades and a colorful nautical procession featuring the carnival king Vaval. It is one of the southern Guadeloupe islands that maintains its carnival tradition.

events.name: Les Nuits de la Guitare de Patrimonio
events.blurb: A renowned international guitar festival held each July at the open-air Theatre de Verdure in Patrimonio, just outside Saint-Florent, featuring jazz, blues, flamenco, rock and world-class guitarists since 1990. The 2026 edition runs 20-27 July.

events.name: Porto Latino
events.blurb: A Latin and world-music festival founded in 1998 in Saint-Florent's citadel; it has since grown and relocated to nearby Bastia, with the 2026 edition scheduled for 5-7 August.

events.name: Saint-Erasme (Saint Erasmus, patron of fishermen) sea procession
events.blurb: On Saint Erasmus' day, the patron saint of fishermen, the saint's statue is carried aboard a boat in a procession across the Gulf of Saint-Florent, a long-standing local maritime tradition.

events.name: Les Nuits Salines
events.blurb: Annual music festival in Batz-sur-Mer held between Place du Murier and Esplanade Salies-de-Bearn. The 2026 edition (24-26 July) centers on Breton culture with Breton song, dance and traditional music, featuring acts such as Plantec, Les Ramoneurs de Menhirs and Sonerien Du.

events.name: Pardon Saint-Guenole
events.when: annually on the third Sunday of August (2026: 16 August)
events.blurb: A Breton religious festival held in Batz-sur-Mer every year since 1919, dedicated to Saint Guenole. It features a blessing of the salt during Mass, a procession of the patron saint's statue from the Chapelle du Murier, and a parade of paludiers (salt workers) in traditional costume celebrating Breton heritage.

events.name: Fete de la Musique
events.blurb: Batz-sur-Mer's edition of France's nationwide music day, held at Parc Freour and Place du Garnal with performances by local musical groups.
